items.item_text: Licensed Clinical Social Worker:CA (LCSW:CA)Masters Degree from an accredited school of Social Work
One (1) year post graduate experience in a clinic setting
Experience in medical and psychiatric social work, crises intervention, and abuse
Comprehensive Assessment & Care: Conduct timely, holistic assessments by incorporating psycho-social, spiritual, and cultural factors to create, implement, and modify individualized plans of care.

Clinical Intervention & Therapy: Diagnose mental health disorders and provide evidence-based psychotherapeutic interventions, utilizing sound clinical judgment to treat behavioral conditions and manage crises.

Patient Education & Advocacy: Identify learning barriers and educational needs, providing effective instruction to patients and families while ensuring privacy, dignity, and professional communication.

Collaborative Care Coordination: Actively partner with the multidisciplinary healthcare team, physicians, and allied health staff to coordinate services, facilitate care conferences, and ensure seamless discharge planning.
Regulatory Compliance & Reporting: Adhere to all legal and ethical standards, including the mandatory reporting of suspected abuse or neglect and knowledge of bioethical committee resources.
Support & Mentorship: Provide professional support to staff through education on social service issues, facilitate training for interns, and coordinate referrals to necessary community resources.
